# 諸法無行經

**ID:** T0650
**Volume:** T15
**Category:** 經集部類
**Original Category:** 經集部
**Byline:** 姚秦 鳩摩羅什譯
**Dynasty:** 姚秦
**Date:** 402–412
**Juans:** 2

## Contributors
- 鳩摩羅什 (A001583)

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

T650 (two fascicles; Sanskrit *Sarvadharmapravṛttinirdeśa-sūtra*, "Sūtra Setting Forth the Operation of All Dharmas") is [鳩摩羅什](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%B3%A9%E6%91%A9%E7%BE%85%E4%BB%80)'s Yáo-Qín translation of a major Mahāyāna *prajñāpāramitā* exposition. The Chinese title — "all dharmas have no practice" — is a polemical reading: from the absolute *prajñā* perspective, no *dharma* is the agent of any practice, since all *dharma*s are devoid of intrinsic nature. The text is closely paralleled by [T651](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0289) (*Fóshuō zhūfǎ běnwú jīng*) and [T652](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0290) (the Northern Song *Dàshèng suízhuǎn xuānshuō*).

**Abstract**

T650 is unanimously ascribed to [鳩摩羅什](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%B3%A9%E6%91%A9%E7%BE%85%E4%BB%80) in the canonical bibliographies. Date bracket follows his Cháng'ān period (401–413). The Sanskrit *Sarvadharmapravṛttinirdeśa* survives in a Tibetan version and in fragments. The text is a vigorous statement of the *anutpattikadharmakṣānti* — the forbearance of the non-arising of *dharma*s — and was a key source for Madhyamaka exegesis in China; it is cited extensively in *[the Dà zhìdù lùn](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6c/KR6c0005)* (T1509, also Kumārajīva's translation). The *Sarvadharmapravṛttinirdeśa* is one of the most radical statements of the *prajñāpāramitā* paradox that the bodhisattva path consists in *not* practising any *dharma* — i.e., that all real practice is the realization that no *dharma* has any intrinsic mode of operation.
